repairs.rootCause: The strict gate hard-coded goal-contract.json even when brand-evidence.json identified the frozen v2 goal.
repairs.resolution: The gate now resolves the goal contract whose goalId matches brand-evidence.goalId, with goal-contract.json only as fallback.
